d.d: Initialism of kill on sight: used in addition to a target player's username to alert teammates of a suspicious player that should be killed when seen.
third-person singular simple present indicative of KO
Fit for use or consumption, in accordance with Jewish law (especially relating to food).
d.x: Only in New York can you find a good, kosher hamburger!

d.d: Observant of the rules of kashrut (of a person or establishment).
d.x: "Are you kosher?" "No, I love to eat scallops."

d.d: In accordance with standards or usual practice.
d.x: Is what I have done kosher with Mr. Smith?

d.d: In a kosher manner; in accordance with kashrut.
To kasher; to prepare (for example, meat) in conformity with the requirements of the Jewish law.
